_doc: CHG-ESTACK-ASSESSMENT-ACCURACY-001 — lot B6: assessment accuracy. Database clock (UTC epoch and zone offset; the gateway publishes clock_check against its own clock) and the CONTAINER_DATA scope of the diagnostic account (which containers the CDB_* and filtered V$ views really cover).
